Sorry, that's a frustrating one. Twitching fans with the LCD alive on USB-C usually means the main power rail isn't coming up, not the fans.

First, was it ever run above 6 TH/s? Overclocked or modified units aren't covered, and a self-replaced fuse may count, so I want to be straight with you.

I'm confirming the exact warranty terms for your unit with the team. They pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and reply to your email.

Fastest help right now is our Discord, mention @nullhashrate: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf
Its completely stock.  Never overclocked.  I only replaced the fuse because it was clearly blown and the miner was off.  I used exact 20A mini blade fuse that was in there.  Let me know thanks.

Good, that helps. Stock settings and a like for like fuse is exactly what we'd want to hear.

Next step is the RMA intake so you get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put order Shop···· on it and note the blown fuse, the replacement, and that the LCD lights on USB-C while the fans only twitch. Processing takes up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse.

The team confirms your exact warranty terms tomorrow at 10am ET, by email.
ok. thanks.  I'll wait for your email tommorrow

Sounds good. It'll come to this address tomorrow.

Before you go, one thing: you've gone with several small miners, three NerdQaxe++ and a stack of Bitaxes, rather than one bigger unit. What's behind that?
I live in LA power is very expensive

Makes sense, LA rates are brutal.

So is it mostly about keeping the draw small enough to live with, or about spreading the risk across several units instead of one?
plus the heat and sound

Fair, those units run quiet enough to share a room with.

Last one: where do they actually sit in the house, and which of the three bothers you most, the heat, the noise or the bill?
the sound

Noted, thanks for telling me. That's genuinely useful for us.
